SpeedTreeOBSE v169 VERIFIED: size adjustment i=1+leafSizeIncreaseFactor*i, matching RT4.1 LeafGeometry::InitClusters width/height multiplier. New mesh scale consumes the already-published native STSP.w, avoiding a separate guessed LOD formula.
